notes: Reference crop for the pale GTA map texture visible behind the leadership quote cards. The crop is style reference only; the production WebP is generated from geographically accurate Toronto/GTA map data and not from crop pixels.

assets.label: GTA leadership background map
assets.role: Pale editorial background map for the Fairlend leadership section
assets.rationale: The asset is a complex raster map texture with fine street geometry, pale tonal treatment, district labels, pins, water, and a CN Tower landmark motif. It should be generated as a standalone background image rather than represented as live UI.

generation.prompt: Generate a polished pale editorial background map plate inspired by the reference crop, but geographically accurate to Toronto within the GTA. The map should show the central Toronto / downtown waterfront context, including Yorkville to the north, the Financial District near the center, Harbourfront and Lake Ontario toward the lower area, and a subtle CN Tower landmark marker. Use fine cream and warm-gray street linework, muted district labels, small orange proof pins, soft paper texture, low contrast, no UI cards, no webpage chrome, no unrelated text, no fantasy geography.
generation.negative_prompt: Do not render quote cards, people, UI, browser chrome, fake city names, misspelled labels, dark roads, saturated colors, or a copied screenshot crop.
